item.title: Amid national backlash, Colorado lawmakers pledge more oversight, accountability for ICE agents
item.description: Senate Bill 5 would allow Coloradans to file lawsuits against federal authorities who violate a person’s constitutional rights during civil immigration enforcement activities.

item.description: The Republican president said the work would cost about $200 million.
